title: Intrinsic realization of finite-reduction twist reassociation
statement: In the finite setting P, let 1 <= m <= P.level and Q be the smaller setting. Let f:X -> Y be a smooth separated morphism of relative dimension d between separated finite-type schemes over the base. Let K be finite-Tor constructible in the intrinsic pro-etale derived category on Y. Write E and E' for the realizations, red for reduction, tau for smoothPurityReassociation [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], c_source for finiteReductionSourceComparison [def-pur-finite-reduction-comparisons], and c_tensor for the independent tensor-source comparison [def-pur-finite-reduction-tensor-source]. Then red_X(E_X(tau_P at f^*E_Y.inverse K)) followed by c_tensor(K) equals c_source(K) followed by E'_X(tau_Q at f^*E'_Y.inverse(red_Y K)). This asserts only the reassociation square; no exceptional inverse image or purity morphism occurs.

proof.text: Put L=E_Y.inverse K. Transport the finite-Tor condition along E_Y.counitIso.app K. Apply the fixed-scalar reassociation square to L and then apply the smaller realization E'_X.

Use naturality of scalarPresentation at tau. Expand finiteTensorPuritySourceComparison, cancelling the realization units. This gives the intrinsic shifted-source comparison at E_Y(L). Change this input to K through the realization counit: source-comparison naturality, pullback functoriality, twist/shift naturality and the equivalence triangle identities give the source comparison at K. The target input change is precisely finiteReductionTensorInputComparison, hence its tensor image is the final factor of finiteReductionTensorSourceComparison. Compose these equalities to obtain the displayed reassociation square.
